entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6257641627989839744: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.2032 +/- 0.0212 mas (same row, RUWE 1.10): 161.21 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -90.984, -31.460 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.784 +/- 0.051 solar radii from Christiansen et al. 2022, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-408 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..244C/abstract). Mass 0.813 +/- 0.368 solar masses from Christiansen et al. 2022, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-408 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..244C/abstract). Temperature 5335 +/- 138 K from Christiansen et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-408 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 5,335 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffebdc. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,335 K and log g 4.56 (u1 0.564, u2 0.190): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
